name: Core Space Renderer
definition: A rendering algorithm that traverses a hierarchical acceleration structure (AS) consisting of a core grid, µLAS (proxy geometry level), mLAS (mesostructure level), and nLAS (nanostructure level). It uses virtual instancing to render molecular data without updating acceleration structures during traversal.
summary: The Core Space Renderer visualizes biological interiors using a uniform grid for efficient ray culling, distinguishing itself from the Shell Space Renderer by skipping empty space to determine valid ray intervals.
